events.name: Vegas Golden Knights at Detroit Red Wings

headlines.description: — Tomas Hertl scored a power-play goal with 2:49 remaining in overtime and the Vegas Golden Knights rallied from a two-goal, third-period deficit to edge the Detroit Red Wings 4-3 on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Hertl scores in OT to cap Vegas rally in 4-3 victory over Red Wings

events.name: Toronto Maple Leafs at New Jersey Devils

headlines.description: — Paul Cotter and Jesper Bratt scored in the shootout, Connor Brown forced overtime with a tying goal with 2:21 left in the third period and the New Jersey Devils beat Toronto 4-3 on Wednesday night, sending the Maple Leafs to their fifth straight loss.
headlines.shortLinkText: Cotter and Bratt score in shootout after Brown forces OT in Devils' 4-3 win over Maple Leafs

headlines.description: — Nikolaj Ehlers sealed his seventh career hat trick with an empty-net goal and the Carolina Hurricanes held off the Vancouver Canucks for a 6-4 victory on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Nikolaj Ehlers' hat trick leads Hurricanes past Canucks 6-4

events.name: New York Islanders at Anaheim Ducks

headlines.description: — Cutter Gauthier scored twice in a span of just over three minutes in the first period, backup Ville Husso stopped 42 shots and the Anaheim Ducks beat the New York Islanders 5-1 on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Cutter Gauthier scores twice, Ville Husso has 42 saves in Ducks' 5-1 win over Islanders

events.name: St. Louis Blues at Seattle Kraken

headlines.description: — Dylan Holloway scored the go-ahead goal in the second period, Brayden Schenn had three assists and the St. Louis Blues beat the Seattle Kraken 3-2 on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Blues beat Kraken 3-2 to halt Seattle's 5-game home winning streak
